title.zh: 修订第328号共和国法第11条（即Calbayog市 Charter）的法案
title.en: An Act Further Amending Section Eleven of Republic Act Numbered Three Hundred Twenty-Eight, Otherwise Known as the Charter of the City of Calbayog
title.orig: An Act Further Amending Section Eleven of Republic Act Numbered Three Hundred Twenty-Eight, Otherwise Known as the Charter of the City of Calbayog

text.en:
The last paragraph of Section eleven of Republic Act Numbered Three hundred twenty-eight, as amended, is further amended to read as follows:
"The members of the Municipal Board shall each receive a salary of two thousand four hundred pesos per annum: Provided, However, That they shall not be entitled to collect any per diems and travelling allowances when performing their duties within the city."

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 18, 1960.
